concerns.text: T002 loads only two datasets and tags 'FR-001 (partial: 2 of 3 datasets)'. FR-001 is a MUST for ≥3 datasets; the spec was never revised, so the task list permanently ships a weakened FR with only a research.md note. Either amend FR-001 in spec.md (staged relaxation) or add a third verified dataset task; a task-side 'partial' tag is silent weakening.

T007 'reinterprets FR-021/FR-022 per plan Phase 5' with a two-control design, but spec FR-021/FR-022 still mandate a single column-permutation control as ground truth for BOTH FP and FN rates. The spec text was never amended, so the tasks contradict a live FR. Amend FR-021/FR-022 in spec.md to the two-control design before tasks execute it.

T008 computes 'False-positive rate for marginal tests' and 'False-negative rate for correlation tests' from the correlation-perturbation control, while plan.md Phase 5 and data-model.md §6 state the same control provides 'false-positive rates for correlation tests'. The artifacts assign opposite error-type semantics to the same control; the FP/FN numbers T008 produces will not match the plan/data-model description. Reconcile (T008's semantics are statistically correct; fix plan/data-model or make the mapping explicit).

Principle VI mandates Fisher's z-transformed correlation deviations for every generator evaluation, and the metric-results schema includes a 'fisher_z_deviation' field, but T006's correlation.py computes only Pearson/Spearman absolute differences and the permutation test. No task computes Fisher's z deviations — a constitution-mandated metric with no implementing work. Add it to T006.

'should any step inadvertently require CUDA, the execution engine auto-offloads to a free Kaggle GPU' directly contradicts FR-002's 'No GPU usage is permitted' and constitution Principle VII's CPU-only framing. Remove the GPU escape-hatch sentence or amend FR-002; a tasks document may not silently override an explicit spec prohibition.

T007 applies 'fixed seed 42' to all three control/baseline datasets, but the spec pins seed 42 only for the FR-019 noise baseline and leaves control seeds unspecified. Harmless (pinning improves reproducibility) but the extension of a spec constraint should be recorded, e.g. noted in T012/research.md or spec FR-021.
